source_analysis.skill: Solve a first-order separable ODE and isolate its dependent variable in explicit form; select the general solution or fill its designated mathematical factor.
reasoning_steps: Separate h(x)g(y) as dy/g(y)=h(x)dx on a nonzero domain.
Integrate both sides, retaining one arbitrary constant.
Invert the dependent-variable antiderivative, rescale or rename the arbitrary constant, and retain both square-root branches where appropriate.
Compare complete candidate solution families, or provide only the expression requested by a blank.
invariants: Separation, elementary integration, and explicit inversion are the assessed operations.
The correct option must represent the full general family on valid local domains, not one particular solution.
One correct radio option with four mathematically distinct distractors.
Prompt, answer, bank, and worked solution must refer to the same differential equation and parameters.
permitted_variations: Small nonzero signed coefficients, low polynomial powers and affine numerators, preserving integration workload.
Eligible placement and magnitude of coefficients inside and outside inverse functions; derive every option from the resulting equation.
Shuffle correct answer position and vary distractor mistakes rather than preserving a unique superficial signature.
Vary easy source family and relevant antiderivative, with constant names or option ordering as irrelevant counterfactuals.
Moderate-only elementary trig factors and self-contained contextual blank coefficients, retaining their response contracts.
